title: Purple Sorceress Warrior
description: A young woman with white and purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears ornate white and purple traditional armor with a spiked crown, holds a large curved purple scythe in her right hand, and summons a swirling vortex of purple magical energy in her left hand.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian female sorceress with long white hair tied in a topknot and bangs, wearing ornate white and purple traditional fantasy armor with a spiked purple crown, standing in a combat stance. She holds a large curved purple scythe in one hand while her other hand summons a swirling vortex of dark purple magical energy. Dramatic lighting, clean digital painting style, solid dark gray background.
